companion_page_right_sidebar_show_label: Show right sidebar: web page and background tasks
companion_page_model_moved: Her model is chosen next to the chat box.
companion_agent_mode_default_desc: Does things like checking status and reading chat right away; asks you before anything risky (pressing keys, sending messages, changing settings, downloading, launching games…)
companion_agent_mode_allow_all_desc: Does everything without asking (anything you set to “Block” stays blocked)
companion_agent_mode_read_only_desc: Can only check status, read the screen and speak; everything else is blocked
companion_agent_tool_unavailable_desc: Tools not available right now (their rules are kept)
companion_agent_section_desc: Who handles what you say in a call, and what she does right away versus asks you first.
companion_agent_in_game_desc: What you say in a call, after the wake word, or through a quick command goes to her (multi-step, with all tools). When off, the old one-shot companion is used.
companion_agent_progress_speech_desc: If she hasn't spoken after 1.5 s, she says something like “OK, let me check” so you're not left waiting.
companion_agent_match_recap_desc: When the game closes, she sums up the match (your conversation, reminders and automations) in a few lines in the chat, and writes what she learned into that game's memory. Only for matches over 3 min where you called her; each recap is one AI call.
companion_agent_match_recap_on: She'll recap each match when it ends
companion_agent_effort_desc: DeepSeek only. In a call she doesn't think by default, so replies come faster (with thinking on, a reply often takes 10+ seconds longer). The chat window uses the provider's default (high).
companion_agent_effort_chat_aria: Thinking effort in the chat window
companion_agent_effort_chat_saved: Thinking effort for the chat window saved
companion_agent_safety_check_desc: DeepSeek's official content safety check, at no extra cost. If a reply fails the check, it's withdrawn and you're told. DeepSeek only.
companion_agent_rules_hint: “Default” depends on the tool's side effects. Whether she may use each saved automation is set one by one on the Automation page.
companion_interaction_ptt_desc: Hold to talk, release to send
companion_interaction_dictation_desc: Tap to record, tap again to stop and confirm
companion_interaction_one_shot_desc: Tap to record; sends when you pause
companion_ai_choose_connection_hint: Choose a connection and set its API key.
companion_voice_input_desktop_only: Voice input is only available in the desktop app
companion_voice_input_hint_ptt: Hold the button to talk, release to send. When it's focused, Space or Enter works too
companion_voice_input_hint_one_shot: Sends automatically when you finish speaking
companion_browser_cleared: Cleared the built-in browser's sign-ins and site data
companion_browser_extension_added: Extension added. Takes effect when you reopen the page
companion_browser_extension_pick_title: Choose an unpacked extension folder (Chrome / Edge extension, one with manifest.json)
companion_browser_desc: The Web tab in the chat page's right sidebar: you can browse there yourself, and she uses it in the background to look things up and work web pages for you. Accounts you sign in to there are stored only in Kotone on this PC. Music plays on the Music page.
companion_browser_enabled_desc: When off, the right sidebar has no Web tab, open pages close, and she stops opening web pages (from the next conversation). Sign-ins and extensions are kept and come back when you turn it on again.
companion_browser_enabled_off: Built-in browser turned off; the Web tab is hidden
companion_browser_clear_desc: Signs out of every account in the right-side web panel and deletes its site data. Any music playing will stop.
companion_browser_extensions_desc: Add Chrome / Edge extensions to the right-side web panel (an ad blocker, for example). Only unpacked extension folders are supported. Adding or disabling one takes effect when you reopen the page.
companion_browser_clear_dialog_desc: Every account you signed in to in the chat page's web panel (NetEase Cloud Music, for example) will be signed out. Sign in again next time you need it.
companion_bubble_desc: A small window on the game's screen. Usually it's a one-line bubble: what she's hearing, thinking and saying, or a line a plugin pushes. When a plugin pushes a card it opens into a mini window with the pushes from the chat; scroll back for earlier ones. It never takes the game's focus. You can close it (×) and drag it, and it comes back where you left it; it stays while your mouse is over it. It can't show over a game in exclusive fullscreen.
companion_bubble_enabled_desc: When off, she replies only by voice and floating text, and pushes still go into the chat. Voice input's input bar is never used to show her.
companion_bubble_corner_desc: Until you drag it, it sits in this corner of the game's screen, clear of voice input's input bar. Once dragged, it stays where you put it.
companion_bubble_offset_desc: For games with a minimap in the bottom-right corner (like League of Legends), move it a bit toward the center. Ignored once you've dragged it.
companion_bubble_danmaku_label: Also show replies as floating text
companion_bubble_danmaku_desc: By default, replies show only in the floating window. Timed reminders still use floating text.
companion_bubble_danmaku_on: Replies also show as floating text
companion_bubble_danmaku_off: Replies show only in the floating window
companion_bubble_reset_desc: After dragging it somewhere else, put it back in the corner above.
companion_bubble_reset_done: Floating window is back in its corner
companion_call_desc: Press the call key and {name} listens to you. Choose below how she listens after you press it.
companion_call_hotkey_desc: Default is Ctrl + ~ (~ is the key below Esc). Leave it empty to skip the call key and use only the chat page button or the wake word.
companion_call_mode_aria: How she listens after you call her
companion_call_mode_one_shot_desc: She listens to one sentence and takes it when you stop. After answering she goes quiet, and listens a bit longer only if she asked you something.
companion_call_mode_dictation_desc: Press once to start listening, press again to stop and hand it to her. The wake word and the call button work like One-shot.
companion_call_mode_call_desc: Always listening: just talk, and you can cut in while she speaks. Say “退下” (dismiss), press again, or stay silent for a while to hang up.
companion_call_idle_desc: Hang up after this long with no one talking (time doesn't count while {name} is speaking, working, or waiting for your confirmation).
companion_call_idle_aria: Silence before a call hangs up
companion_call_idle_saved: Calls hang up after {seconds} s of silence
companion_call_echo_desc: Filters out sound from your speakers ({name}'s voice, game audio) so you can cut in just by talking while she speaks. When off, she doesn't listen while speaking; press the call key to interrupt her. Fine to leave on with headphones.
companion_call_echo_on: You can interrupt her even on speakers
companion_quick_screen_desc: When you call her or press a quick command hotkey, she first captures the game window and reads the chat, then sets reminders, types, or replies by voice / floating text.
companion_quick_upload_warning: Text recognition is using an online model: every call uploads a game screenshot to the provider.
companion_quick_auto_send_label: Send automatically after typing for you
companion_quick_auto_send_desc: By default she sends the message as soon as it's typed. When off, she only types it into the chat box, and you check it and press Enter yourself.
companion_quick_chat_region_desc: The chat box position for this game is remembered; next time only that area is read.
companion_quick_moved: Hotkeys that say a line to her for you are added and changed in Settings → Hotkeys (where you can also add hotkeys that run an automation, call a tool or open a page).
companion_danmaku_top_invalid: Enter a whole number of pixels from 0 to 2160.
companion_danmaku_top_not_saved: Distance from top wasn't saved. Enter it again or press Enter to retry.
companion_danmaku_desc: Text notices that float across the top of the game screen.
companion_danmaku_top_px_aria: Floating text distance from top, in pixels
companion_danmaku_top_help: Adjusted automatically if it goes off screen.
companion_danmaku_preview: Preview (scaled down from a 1920-wide screen: size, height and speed match the game)
companion_identity_switched: Switched to {name}. Your next message starts a new conversation
companion_identity_soul_saved: Personality saved. Takes effect in the next conversation
companion_identity_wake_unusable: This wake word can't be used
companion_identity_wake_saved: Wake word saved (takes effect right away if voice wake-up is on)
companion_identity_avatar_too_large: Avatar must be 2 MB or smaller
companion_identity_voice_follow: Use the voice from How she replies
companion_identity_desc: Each character has her own name, avatar, personality, voice and wake word. Memories about you, game memory, skills and settings are shared by all characters, so switching won't make her forget you. Switching starts a new conversation.
companion_identity_builtin_desc: Built-in character: your changes are stored in your workspace, and you can restore the default anytime.
companion_identity_name_desc: Up to {limit} characters; she also calls herself by this name
companion_identity_avatar_desc_faces: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 2 MB. Without one, the built-in expressions are used
companion_identity_avatar_desc_letter: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 2 MB. Without one, the first letter of the name is shown
companion_identity_voice_desc: The voice she speaks with (only applies if it belongs to the current speech engine; see Interaction → Voice and floating text)
companion_identity_wake_desc: Say this to wake her (when Voice wake-up is on). Leave it empty for the default: “{wake}”. 4 characters work best, such as her name said twice.
companion_identity_wake_ok: The wake model recognizes this word
companion_identity_wake_experimental: Custom wake words are experimental: if she doesn't wake up, try a longer word with clearer sounds.
companion_identity_card_desc: Exports as Character Card V2 (.json; other apps can read the name and description). Voice and wake word go in extensions.kotone.
companion_identity_soul_desc: Her speaking style and principles, read once at the start of each conversation. You can also just tell her “keep it shorter from now on” and she'll ask whether to update this.
companion_output_delivery_required: Keep at least one reply mode
companion_output_fullscreen_hint: Floating text doesn't work in exclusive fullscreen; use borderless fullscreen or windowed mode.
companion_output_desc: The voice and floating text used for reminders, replies and automation results.
companion_output_default_delivery_desc: Used when a reminder doesn't specify one.
companion_memory_user_desc: Your habits and preferences she's noted (what to call you, language, the role you usually play…).
companion_memory_user_placeholder:
- Call me Lin
- Speak English with teammates
companion_memory_notes_desc: Long-term notes across games: your setup, agreements, lessons learned. When they fill up, she condenses them herself.
companion_memory_games_desc: One per game: keybinds, maps, your playstyle. She reads it only while you play that game.
companion_memory_games_empty: None yet. While playing, tell her “remember…” and she'll save it to that game's memory.
companion_memory_delete_desc: She'll forget what she noted for this game. This can't be undone.
companion_runs_title: Stopping speech recognition doesn't affect reminders. Reminders don't fire after you quit Kotone.
companion_reminder_status_changed: The reminder's status has changed; check the updated list
companion_reminder_preview_notice: UI preview; no real reminders are created.
companion_reminder_text_placeholder: e.g. Remind me in 5 min that their jungler has Flash
companion_reminder_hint: Stopping speech recognition doesn't affect reminders. Reminders don't fire after you quit Kotone.
companion_skills_import_unavailable: Skills can't be imported in the browser preview
companion_skills_pick_title: Choose a folder that contains SKILL.md
companion_skills_imported: Imported “{name}”. Takes effect in the next conversation
companion_skills_desc: A skill teaches her one kind of task (callout phrases, build ideas for a game…). Same format as agentskills.io, so you can copy them to friends.
companion_skills_empty: No skills yet. Import one someone shared, or ask her to “turn this into a skill”.
companion_skills_open_folder_title: Open folder (to share, copy the whole folder)
companion_skills_delete_desc: The whole skill folder will be deleted. This can't be undone.
companion_speech_desc: Reminders, replies and automation results are read aloud in this voice.
companion_speech_kokoro_desc: About 147 MB; runs locally after download.
companion_speech_auto_deepseek: Using DeepSeek voice (through her DeepSeek API connection): billed per character, and every spoken line sends the text to DeepSeek; repeated lines reuse the cache. Speed can't be adjusted.
companion_speech_auto_info: Uses DeepSeek voice when her API connection is DeepSeek (with an API key); otherwise uses the Windows system voice.
companion_speech_deepseek_info: DeepSeek voice: by default uses the DeepSeek connection and API key from your API connections, billed per character (each Chinese character counts as 2). Every spoken line sends the text to DeepSeek; repeated lines reuse the cache, and speed can't be adjusted. You can pick a different connection in Settings → Models → Text-to-speech.
companion_speech_online_info: Online voice: every spoken line sends the text to the provider. Set the connection, model and voice in Settings → Models → Text-to-speech. Repeated lines reuse the cache without a new request.
companion_usage_desc: What conversations, summaries, online voice and text recognition have cost. Cached input is much cheaper (on DeepSeek, about 1/50 of uncached input).
companion_usage_unpriced: {count} of these calls have no price (the model isn't in the price list), so only tokens were counted.
companion_usage_compact_desc: When a conversation reaches about this many tokens, the older part is condensed into a summary, and from then on only the summary and the last few turns are used (that one summary costs a bit extra, then caching works again). 0 = never summarize.
companion_wake_desc: No key needed: say “{word}” to wake {name}, then say what you need.
companion_wake_enabled_desc: When on, the microphone stays open (the Windows taskbar always shows the mic in use). The wake word is detected only on this PC and never uploaded. Headphones recommended: game audio from speakers can wake her by mistake.
companion_wake_model_desc: About 5 MB, downloaded from the official sherpa-onnx releases page (the archive is about 33 MB; only the needed files are kept). The model's training data is licensed for non-commercial use only, so it isn't bundled with the installer.
companion_wake_phrase_desc: Four characters are less likely to be set off by other speech.
companion_wake_role_phrase_desc: {name}'s own wake word; change it under Character.
companion_wake_sensitivity_desc: Lower it if she often wakes up by mistake; raise it if she doesn't respond when you call.
companion_wake_ack_desc: If you pause after the wake word, she answers before listening; if you keep talking, she doesn't. It ends if you say nothing for 5 s after waking her.
companion_workspace_saved: Saved “{label}”. Takes effect in the next conversation
companion_pushes_popup_label: Open the mini window for pushes
companion_pushes_popup_desc: When a plugin pushes a card (or an update it wants you to see again), the mini window opens at that card; click the line above a card to open the chat. It closes 8 seconds after your mouse leaves and doesn't open while a Kotone window is in front. Every push is recorded in the chat, and each has its own switch in the plugin's page under Settings → Pushes.
